name: Job-Application-Tracker
description: Track your job search on your own server, with a Kanban board, recruiter CRM and insights

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your whole job search: the SQLite database, a plain-text export (JSON Lines), Markdown notes, attached files and emails, and the git history of automatic snapshots. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Job Application Tracker web app and API, published on host as 6172

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.
